interpret.need: Determine the total number of campaigns that have been sent.
interpret.echo: How many campaigns have been sent in this branch?

task.goal: Count campaigns that have at least one delivered message

task_results.sql:
SELECT
    
    COUNT(DISTINCT campaigns.id)::bigint AS campaigns_sent

FROM (
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.organization_id,
  c.branch_id,
  c.name,
  c.description,
  c.status,
  c.starts_at,
  c.ends_at,
  c.source_channel,
  c.created_by_user_id,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  c.goal,
  c.objective,
  c.session_id,
  c.audience_summary,
  c.audience_count,
  c.launch_plan,
  c.launch_local_date,
  c.launch_local_time,
  c.timezone
FROM campaign.campaigns c
WHERE c.organization_id = 1000
  AND c.branch_id = 1000

) campaigns
WHERE TRUE
  AND TRUE
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign.campaign_channels ch WHERE ch.campaign_id = campaigns.id AND ch.organization_id = 1000 AND ch.channel <> 'ppc')
  AND TRUE

  AND status IN ('live','completed','cancelled')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM campaign.campaign_send_recipients r
    JOIN campaign.campaign_send_batches b ON b.id = r.batch_id
    WHERE r.campaign_id = campaigns.id AND r.organization_id = 1000
      AND ((CASE
  WHEN lower(coalesce(r.status,'')) IN ('failed','cancelled') THEN 'failed'
  WHEN lower(coalesce(r.status,'')) = 'skipped' THEN 'skipped'
  WHEN lower(coalesce(r.status,'')) IN ('stub','stub_sent') THEN 'stub'
  WHEN lower(coalesce(r.provider_message_id,'')) LIKE 'stub-%'
    OR lower(coalesce(r.provider_message_id,'')) LIKE 'stub://%' THEN 'stub'
  WHEN lower(coalesce(r.status,'')) IN ('bounced','hard_bounce','soft_bounce') THEN 'bounce'
  WHEN lower(coalesce(r.skip_fail_reason,'')) LIKE '%bounce%' THEN 'bounce'
  WHEN lower(coalesce(r.status,'')) IN ('sent','delivered') THEN 'sent'
  ELSE 'pending'
END) = 'sent')
  )
